interface.shortDescription: Stage-gated AI workflow for early product discovery.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin wrapper for the zero-to-one-product-discovery workflow skill. It helps agents handle early product, open-source, side-project, and startup ideas through evidence-aware stage gates instead of prematurely producing PRDs, roadmaps, ADRs, or implementation plans.
defaultPrompt: Explore my early product idea without rushing into PRD.
Review this product concept and find the riskiest assumptions.
Turn my vague open-source idea into a grounded discovery flow.
